Before you book

Common Questions

Do you come to my home?
Yes. We do not have a showroom. A specialist comes to your home, apartment or strata building anywhere across Sydney to inspect the leak.
What happens at the inspection?
We work out where the water is actually escaping, whether that is the silicone, the grout, the membrane or the base. You then get a fixed scope quote in writing before any work begins.
How long does a repair take?
Most resealing and regrouting jobs are finished in a single day, and the shower is usually ready to use again within 24 hours.
Do you work on strata and commercial properties?
Yes. We regularly repair strata, body corporate and commercial bathroom and balcony leaks across Sydney.
What should I include in my enquiry?
Your suburb and a short description of what you have noticed, such as water marks on the ceiling below, damp skirting boards, loose tiles or mould. It helps us arrange the right inspection.
